criteria.notes: The clock keeps time dominant while redistributing metadata for compact, portrait, square, landscape, and ultra-wide zones.
No external visual reference was declared; the instruction-led single-hero clock brief is the review authority.
Ratio-specific metadata placement and one unambiguous time hero avoid dashboard chrome and generic cards.
Primary hierarchy and operational values remain legible at each rendered signage distance and target ratio.
Every rendered preset and state was inspected; text, status, and surface contrast remain readable after theme changes.
Long, compact, wrapped, and descender-bearing labels show complete ink or deliberate ellipsis with no partial lines.
Content fills the declared surface intentionally across fixed and adaptive ratios without overlap or accidental dead space.
Light and dark surfaces, timezone labels, seconds, and invalid-timezone fallback remain visually coherent.
Compared with all other maintained examples; composition, pagination, hierarchy, and visual language remain distinct.
